name: stb_vorbis
license: public domain or MIT (the file's choice; its statements are at its end)
note: stb_vorbis.c at the last commit that changed it (2021-07-12); git blob 3e5c2504c08f76b9d04e4adfbce80818631e835e, SHA-256 in upstream. Modified by solanum-hardening.patch (apply it to the upstream file to get this one): the file vendor and comment parsing of the second header no longer trusts the lengths a file gives. A length or a count that is negative or past 1 MB / 65535 is refused, and a comment list is zeroed and counted as its entries are made. Before it, a damaged header made start_decoder write past a block (len+1 overflowed) or free pointers it had never set; bit-flipped Ogg files crashed the app. src/audiostream.c also gives stb_vorbis one fixed 4 MB block instead of the heap.
